# Cream Cake

## Ingredients

- 3 eggs
- 1 1/2 cupfuls powdered sugar
- 1 tablespoonful lemon-juice
- 1/2 cupful cold water
- 2 cupfuls flour
- 2 teaspoonfuls baking-powder
- 1 1/2 cupfuls milk (for filling)
- 1 tablespoonful flour (for filling)
- 2/3 cupful sugar (for filling)
- 2 eggs (for filling)
- pinch of salt (for filling)
- frosting, preferred type

## Instructions

1. Beat three eggs with one and one-half cupfuls of powdered sugar.
2. Add a tablespoonful of lemon-juice and half a cupful of cold water.
3. Sift in two cupfuls of flour and two teaspoonfuls of baking-powder.
4. Bake in layer-cake tins.
5. Heat one and one-half cupfuls of milk in a double boiler.
6. Beat together one tablespoonful of flour, two-thirds cupful of sugar, two eggs, and a pinch of salt.
7. Add gradually to the boiling milk, stir, and cook for fifteen minutes.
8. Flavor to taste, cool, and put the cake together with the filling.
9. Ice with any preferred frosting.
